## Introduction

The notebook describes the set up of the execution of the nf-core/taxprofiler benchmarking run.

## Requirements

Command line tools used in this notebook includes:

  - `nextflow` (version 25.10.4 build 11173)

## Retrieving pipeline

We will benchmarking with v2.1.0 of nf-core/taxprofiler with Nextflow version 25.10.4.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

## TO UPDATE ######################
nextflow pull nf-core/taxprofiler -r 2.0.0
```

## Pipeline execution

Make a fresh screen session for safety

```{bash}
#| eval: false
screen -R txp
```

## Execution (Ancient DNA Illumina)

We can then run nf-core/taxprofiler on this dataset of 3 differently depth-sequenced samples with the databases we generated previously.  

### 30k

For example, for the full dataset of just under ~30,000 genomes:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
nextflow run nf-core/taxprofiler \
 -r 2.0.0 \
 --input /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-samplesheet_raven.csv \
 --databases /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-databases_raven30000.csv \
 -profile mpcdf,raven \
 -name txp_benchmark_30000 \
 --outdir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/results_illumina_30000/ \
 --perform_shortread_qc \
 --shortread_qc_dedup \
 --perform_shortread_complexityfilter \
 --perform_shortread_redundancyestimation \
 --perform_shortread_hostremoval \
 --hostremoval_reference /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/human-t2t-hla.fa.gz \
 --shortread_hostremoval_index /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/ \
 --run_bracken \
 --run_centrifuge \
 --run_diamond \
 --run_ganon \
 --run_kaiju \
 --run_kmcp \
 --run_kraken2 \
 --run_krakenuniq \
 --run_melon \
 --run_metacache \
 --run_metaphlan \
 --run_motus \
 --run_sylph \
 --run_profile_standardisation \
 --run_krona \
 --taxpasta_taxonomy_dir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/ \
 --sylph_taxonomy /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/sylph_taxonomy.tsv \
 -c custom.config
```

-->

The final custom config (optimised for use on this particular infrastructure) on the two infrastructures used for testing was:

```{groovy}
process {
	withName: 'FASTP_PAIRED' {
		cpus   = 24
		memory = '110.GB'
	}
	withName: 'NONPAREIL_NONPAREIL' {
		ext.args = { "-k 12" } ## aDNA reads are very short
	} 
        withName: 'KAIJU_KAIJU' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'GANON_CLASSIFY' {
                memory = '72.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_KRAKEN2'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'BRACKEN_BRACKEN'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'METACACHE_QUERY' {
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus = '72'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_PRELOADEDKRAKENUNIQ' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
        withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_CENTRIFUGE' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
	withName: 'TAXPASTA_MERGE' {
		errorStrategy = 'ignore' ## Due to bug in MetaPhlAn
		memory = '24.GB'
		cpus = '1'
		time = '4.h'
	}
}


```

### Aggregation

```{bash}
#| eval: false
## WHILE IN `taxprofiler/`
mkdir -p ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/
for i in results_illumina_*; do du --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/taxprofiler_illumina_resource_usage_raw.tsv; done
for i in results_illumina_*; do du -h --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/taxprofiler_illumina_resource_usage_humanreadable.tsv; done
```

To get all trace files

```{bash}
for i in results_illumina_*; do
  mkdir ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/"$i"/
  cp -r "$i"/pipeline_info/ ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/"$i"/pipeline_info/
done
```
